verdict.rationale: Fivetran ships an official MCP server (fivetran-mcp) that supports read-only status/diagnostic queries like sync completion times and broken connections, plus write/delete scope for actions like re-triggering syncs, and the REST API also exposes sync status and manual sync triggers. missing for 10: no independent/hands-on validation of the MCP server's re-trigger functionality in practice, and no explicit doc showing a 'diagnose failure' workflow beyond basic status checks.
